--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,43 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate inputs
+    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result), ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only), ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be 2-dimensional")
+        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
+        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain nonpositive values")
+    
+    # Check shapes match
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")
+    
+    n_candidates = logp_with_result.shape[0]
+    if n_candidates == 0:
+        raise ValueError("Empty input matrices are not allowed")
+    
+    # Validate tau_filter
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("Boolean values are invalid thresholds")
+    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a numeric threshold")
+    tau_filter = float(tau_filter)
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
+    if tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
+    
+    # Compute margins: average over horizon of min(L_no_call - L_with_result, L_no_call - L_call_only)
+    diff_with_result = logp_no_call - logp_with_result
+    diff_call_only = logp_no_call - logp_call_only
+    elementwise_margin = np.minimum(diff_with_result, diff_call_only)
+    margins = np.mean(elementwise_margin, axis=1)
+    
+    # Keep mask: margin > tau_filter
+    keep_mask = margins > tau_filter
+    
+    return keep_mask, margins
